reasons.plausibility: The proposed self-healing passive oxide layer mechanism aligns well with known passivation behavior in multi-element alloys, though some uncertainties remain regarding the detailed kinetics and robustness of film repair under harsh mechanical conditions.
reasons.testability: A clear, controlled wear-corrosion test comparing two treatments under the same conditions provides a direct way to confirm or refute the self-healing oxide film hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a critical aspect of high-entropy alloy design for corrosive-wear environments and outlines a practical experimental approach to quantify improvements and identify underlying mechanisms.
